column1: # TamaPoke custom 32 MB map for the Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-1.75C.
# 3 MB application (same budget as the original 16 MB scheme) and the rest

# for sprites (the full 151 + shinies cannot fit in 32 MB flash).
